ns2:section.sectionText: TOPIC: Sounding Postsocialism: Music & Ethnography in the New Europe Explores relationships between postsocialist lifestyles and changing senses of citizenship and community in contemporary Europe, especially within EU states and others aspiring to EU membership, as evidenced through a wide range of current musical genres and documented in recent ethnomusicological, anthropological, folklore, and cultural studies scholarship. Course topics may include Eurovision, current popular music trends and music videos, music and folklore festivals, new dramatic and theatrical spectacles, contemporary revivals of older customs and rites, technoculture and diaspora communities, and the implication of music in heritage and tourism initiatives, among others. Particular consideration will be given to the tools today?s ethnographers need for engaging with, documenting, and understanding the soundscape of the "New Europe."
